package dynamic_demo

import "core:fmt"

main :: proc() {
	dyn_arr: [dynamic]int

	append(&dyn_arr, 5)

	fmt.println("After first append:")
	fmt.println("Capacity:", cap(dyn_arr))
	fmt.println("Length:", len(dyn_arr))

	for i in 0..<7 {
		append(&dyn_arr, i)
	}

	fmt.println("\nAfter 7 more appends:")
	fmt.println("Capacity:", cap(dyn_arr))
	fmt.println("Length:", len(dyn_arr))

	append(&dyn_arr, 5)

	fmt.println("\nAfter one more append:")
	fmt.println("Capacity:", cap(dyn_arr))
	fmt.println("Length:", len(dyn_arr))
}
